rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a sheep in spoken Cantonese.

example.english: The sheep are grazing in the field.
example.jyutping: joeng4 hai2 cou2 dei6 dou6 sik6 gan2 cou2

rows.note: Use 綿羊 when you want to make clear that you mean a sheep rather than a goat or another kind of 羊.

example.english: This is a sheep, not a goat.
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 hai6 min4 joeng4 m4 hai6 saan1 joeng4

rows.note: Use 羊咩 in child-directed or especially colloquial speech for the animal.

example.english: The child is very happy when they see a sheep.
example.traditional: 細路仔見到羊咩就好開心。
example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 gin3 dou2 joeng4 me1 zau6 hou2 hoi1 sam1
